newsitem.title: USA: Fed expected to add reserves via 3-day system RP.
newsitem.headline: Fed expected to add reserves via 3-day system RP.

text.p: The Federal Reserve is likely to add temporary reserves to the banking system through three-day system repurchase agreements, analysts said.

"Fed funds are trading at 5-1/2 percent this morning after closing at 4-7/8 percent last Friday," said Patricia Thrapp, vice president at Aubrey G. Lanston & Co. "Our estimates indicate that the Fed faces an add need of about $6.75 billion per day over the final three days of the (two-week reserve) maintenance period. We expect the Fed to supply reserves today with a three-day fixed system RP."
"We expect three-day system repos to address the remaining add need for the rest of the period," said analysts at Standard & Poor's MMS.
The Fed refrained from open market action on Friday and added $6.212 billion in temporary reserves to the banking system through four-day fixed system repurchase agreements on Thursday.
